يأتنس (form VIII)
# يَأْتَنِسُ (yaʔtanisu) /jaʔ.ta.ni.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# يَأْتَنِسَ (yaʔtanisa) /jaʔ.ta.ni.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# يَأْتَنِسْ (yaʔtanis) /jaʔ.ta.nis/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
